craft_notes: Sthāyin: secret-joy. Rows: row 2 (object whole line 2). Rupture: dash after Lord. Close: mistress. Rejected: 'bosom' — killed: heart plain; 'queen' — killed: mistress keeps clan-register.

lines: Tell me this secret of secrets, Lord — the heart-dwelling Power,
l4.sanskrit_cite: etad guhyaṃ mahāguhyaṃ kathayasva mama prabho | hṛdayasthā tu yā śaktiḥ kaulinī kulanāyikā

reads_against.argmap: The secret asked is the heart-abiding Kaulinī, mistress of the clan.
